description: This file handles the submission of survey responses within the SuiteCRM platform. It validates request parameters, retrieves associated survey and contact data, processes different question types, records responses in the database, and redirects to a thank-you page or displays a 404 error if validation fails.

methods.name: getCampaignIdFromTracker
methods.description: Fetches the campaign ID associated with a given tracker ID from the database.

parameters.name: trackerId
parameters.description: The tracker ID used to look up the campaign.

methods.name: processSurvey
methods.description: Processes a survey response by creating related database entries for the survey questions, updating happiness scores, and redirecting to a thank-you page.

parameters.name: survey
parameters.description: The survey bean object being responded to.

parameters.name: trackerId
parameters.description: The tracker ID associated with the survey submission.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: ID of the contact responding to the survey.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The HTTP request array containing survey question responses.

methods.name: do404
methods.description: Outputs a 404 error page and terminates execution.
